Product Platform Engineer
description:
- 
 
 Job Purpose 
 - We are seeking an experienced Product Platform Engineer which focuses on building and evolving the underlying platform, APIs, reusable services, and data planes that support modern digital products, with a strong emphasis on telemetry-driven and cloud-native systems. - You will work at the intersection of IoT integration and application development, partnering closely with application engineers, IoT integration engineers, and cloud engineers to design shared platform capabilities. This role emphasizes systems thinking, platform abstractions, and building reliable foundations that enable application teams to deliver features efficiently and at scale. - 
 
 Job Description 
 - - 47 years of professional software engineering experience - Strong experience building backend services using TypeScript and/or Python - Experience designing and working with APIs and microservices - Familiarity with containerized applications using Docker - Experience working with cloud-based systems and integrations - Ability to collaborate across application, platform, and integration teams - Familiarity with Git-based version control and collaborative development workflows - Experience working with IoT or telemetry-driven systems - Hands-on experience or familiarity with AWS IoT SiteWise - Exposure to AWS IoT Greengrass or edge-to-cloud architectures - Experience with event-driven or streaming data systems - Familiarity with deploying and operating microservices in cloud environments - Understanding of platform-style or multi-service architectures - Experience supporting production systems with logging, monitoring, and diagnostics - Interest in improving developer experience through reusable platform tooling - - 
 
 Duties and Responsibilities 
 - As a Product Platform Engineer, you will: - - Design, develop, and maintain shared platform services used across multiple digital products - Build and evolve platform APIs and microservices that application teams rely on - Design and support data planes that move telemetry and operational data from ingestion layers to applications - Contribute to IoT and telemetry integration layers, including processing, normalization, and exposure of data - Work with AWS IoT SiteWisebased solutions to abstract telemetry complexity for application teams - Develop backend services using TypeScript and Python - Build API-driven microservices that enable applications to consume platform capabilities - Package and operate services using containerized deployments (Docker) - Collaborate with application engineers to define data contracts, APIs, and reusable platform components - Partner with cloud engineers on environment integration, deployment practices, and operational concerns - Support observability, diagnostics, and monitoring for platform services and data flows - Identify and resolve systemic issues related to platform reliability, performance, and integration - Contribute to documentation and shared standards for platform and integration development - To adhere to ISMS policies and procedures - -

title: Senior AI Backend Developer (Python & FastAPI)
description:
Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Senior AI Backend Developer with strong expertise in Python and FastAPI to design, build, and integrate enterprise-grade AI solutions. The role focuses on developing scalable REST APIs, integrating Generative AI capabilities, implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and enabling seamless connectivity between AI services and enterprise applications. The ideal candidate combines strong backend engineering skills with practical experience in Large Language Models (LLMs), cloud platforms, and modern AI orchestration frameworks. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable and asynchronous REST APIs for exposing AI and machine learning capabilities. Build backend services using Python and FastAPI to support enterprise AI applications. Integrate GenAI or LLM solutions into business applications and backend workflows. Develop and optimize RAG pipelines to provide secure and contextual information retrieval for AI systems. Implement AI orchestration workflows using LangChain or LangGraph . Build and maintain integrations between AI services and external systems through REST-based interfaces. Design and manage data persistence solutions using SQL databases and appropriate data access patterns. Deploy and support AI-enabled applications in cloud environments using AWS or Azure or GCP . Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve API performance, scalability, reliability, and latency. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, scalable, and production-ready AI solutions. Evaluate real-time versus batch processing approaches and optimize backend services accordingly. Required Skills Proficient Python FastAPI REST APIs GenAI or LLM RAG LangChain or LangGraph SQL AWS or Azure or GCP Intermediate Java/Spring Boot or Go or Node.js Flask / Express.js LlamaIndex / AutoGen NoSQL Experience 4+ years of professional backend software development experience with a focus on API development and integration. 1+ years of experience building or integrating production applications using Generative AI technologies and Large Language Models. Proven experience addressing API performance, scalability, latency, and timeout challenges. Education Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Why Join UST At UST, you will work on technology-driven digital transformation initiatives that solve complex business challenges for global clients. You will gain exposure to cutting-edge AI technologies, collaborate with talented teams worldwide, and benefit from continuous learning, innovation-focused projects, and long-term career growth opportunities.
